Name: Renew and Deploy SSL Certificates

Also, create a short demo GIF for marketing to use in the changelog upon completion.

Name: Ensure Staging Environment Parity
Description: Address the issue of staging environment drifting from production by three migrations. Implement a nightly job that checks for schema differences between staging and production and posts a notification to the infra channel if any divergence is found. Additionally, run the three pending migrations on staging to bring it up to date with production.
